top.line: A Portuguese ATM offered me a 13.6% mark-up on 200 euros, twice; the EU rule it seems to miss; AI as the consumer's evidence.

in-short.line: 200 euros; a guaranteed rate twice; 13.6%; legal if shown; six levers; AI evidence; local currency.

prices.para: The whole cost is in the offer.

screens.line: A rate, a total in pounds and a Union Jack, then the same question again on a second screen.

flow.line: Accept and the ATM's service keeps the margin; decline and my bank converts near the ECB rate.
flow.para: The guarantee protects against almost nothing.

law.line: Regulation 2019/518 Article 3a: show the mark-up as a percentage over the ECB rate before confirming.

levers.line: Certainty against fear, a home anchor, loaded words, asking twice, the setting, borrowed trust.

why.line: Nobody can check at the machine; with an AI agent afterwards, the evidence took minutes.

do.line: Choose the local currency, ask for the mark-up, and complain where it is not shown.
do.para: In Portugal: the bank, the complaints book, Banco de Portugal.

limits.line: One withdrawal, two screens; who runs the conversion unknown; not legal advice.

sources.line: My withdrawal, the PrompTugal.news evidence pack, the ECB rates, the regulations, BEUC and studies.
